dct_title_s: Flood impact assessment in Sao Vicente and Santo Antao Islands, Cabo Verde (13 to 16 August 2025)
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20250812CPV** This map illustrates satellite-detected mudflow extent in Sao Vicente and Santo Islands, Cabo Verde as observed from Pleiades very high-resolution satellite image acquired on 13 to 16 August 2025. Within the analyzed area, approximately, about 16 km² of land appears to be affected by flood. Based on WorldPop population data and the flood extent, approximately 13,600 people are potentially exposed or living close to the flooded areas. Additionally, UNOSAT identified around 4,660 damaged buildings, five damaged bridges, and approximately 85 km of affected roads. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
